title: Photos
description: One photograph per row. The received file is write-once and is never altered (D-13).
x-notes: Advisory AI fields are deliberately excluded from ContentHash: an AI observation arriving later must not void a human approval (C-06).

VisitActivityID.description: Optional. A photograph belongs to a visit; it is attached to an activity only once one has been confirmed. A photographic submission with no activity at all is valid (D-22). References VisitActivities.VisitActivityID

ProjectID.description: Denormalised for row-level security and for folder routing. References Projects.ProjectID

CapturedAt.description: Device capture time where available. Drives the old-photo warning, never a rejection.

ReceivedAt.description: When the controlled system first received the file. The anchor of the write-once guarantee (D-13).

CapturedBy.description: The uploader identity recorded with the original (D-13). References Users.UserID

OriginalFileKey.description: WRITE-ONCE. Never overwritten, altered, annotated, resized or deleted.

OriginalChecksum.description: Taken from the storage provider's own file metadata where available (C-03); computed only as a fallback.

ChecksumAlgorithm.description: Recorded so the value is interpretable years later.

IsOriginalDeviceImageVerified.description: Stays FALSE until real-device testing proves no upstream re-encoding. No file may be described as the original device image while this is FALSE (D-13).

EvidenceStage.description: A supervisor may set it, and often will not. An unclassified photograph is valid evidence and blocks no submission; ClassificationStatus carries how far it has got. Validation: Optional at capture (D-22). Never a mandatory manual field before the photograph is taken

CaptionEN.description: The supervisor's own words. Never overwritten by AI (D-06). Validation: Mandatory for Snag, Observation, Material and Safety stages

CaptureBatchID.description: Groups the photographs captured in one action, so the share and the report both re-use the same stored set. The mechanism behind capture once, use twice (CAP-01).

CaptureSequence.description: Order within the capture batch. Share order and report order derive from this; the supervisor never re-orders by re-selecting files.

IsDuplicateSuspected.description: Flag only. A suspected duplicate is never deleted or merged (S-09).

AnalysisEligibility.description: Decided BEFORE any call is made (D-24). A duplicate, an unusable image, a deleted or excluded one, and an already-analysed one all cost nothing.

PerceptualHash.description: Computed at registration for near-duplicate detection. A flag only: a suspected duplicate is never deleted or merged (S-09).

QualityScore.description: Local blur/exposure measure computed without a model call. Below the project threshold the photograph is retained as evidence and skipped for analysis. Validation: 0.00-1.00

AIObservation.description: ADVISORY ONLY. Schema-validated output, displayed as an AI observation, visually distinct from the caption and the reviewer decision (D-06).

AIProposedEvidenceStage.description: A PROPOSAL. Never written to EvidenceStage. The supervisor confirms or corrects it (D-17).

AIProposedActivityText.description: Free text describing the visible activity. Untrusted. Never becomes the structured activity by itself (D-20, D-23).

AIProposedActivityTypeID.description: A CANDIDATE code the analysis suggests, held in a typed column so it can be shown beside the catalogue entry it points at. It is not the activity: nothing reads it except the confirmation screen, and confirming copies the value into ConfirmedActivityTypeID by an explicit human action (D-23). Validation: Advisory candidate only. No report, rule, calculation, filter or join may read this column References ActivityTypes.ActivityTypeID

ConfirmedActivityTypeID.description: **The trusted structured activity.** Set only by a supervisor or reviewer, and only when ClassificationStatus becomes Confirmed. Reports and business rules read this column and no other (D-23). Validation: Must be permitted for the project by the effective activity rule References ActivityTypes.ActivityTypeID

ClassificationStatus.description: Pending is normal after a Quick Share and blocks nothing. Only Confirmed makes the activity trusted (D-23).

ConfirmedByUserID.description: Who confirmed the classification. Attribution is the point. References Users.UserID

QuarantineStatus.description: Set by the system when access is revoked while evidence is still queued (D-25). Only NotQuarantined and AcceptedIntoProject are readable by a report, a calculation, an approval or a document.

AccessRevokedAt.description: When the capturing user's access ended. The dividing line: evidence captured BEFORE it may complete into quarantine, evidence captured AFTER it is refused.

UploadCompletedAt.description: When the upload was confirmed. No local original may be deleted before this is set (D-25, CAP-GATE G-4).

QuarantineReviewedByUserID.description: Who accepted or rejected the quarantined evidence. Never the revoked user. References Users.UserID

QuarantineRejectionReason.description: MANDATORY when QuarantineStatus is Rejected (D-25). Rejecting evidence without saying why is how evidence disappears quietly.

AIProposedCaptionEN.description: Proposed professional caption. Copied into CaptionEN only by a human action.

AIVisibleCondition.description: Visible condition only. Never a cause, never a compliance judgement (D-20).

AIPossibleSnag.description: Raises a question for the supervisor. Creates no Snag record by itself.

AIImageQualityWarning.description: Blur, exposure, obstruction, framing. Advisory; never blocks a submission.

AIUncertaintyNote.description: What the model could not determine. Required by the analysis schema so that uncertainty is stated rather than hidden.

AIProposalDisposition.description: What the supervisor did with the proposal. Set only by a human (D-17).

AIAnalysedAt.description: In Quick Share this is later than SharedAt, by design.

AIConfidence.description: Advisory. Never a threshold for automatic approval. Validation: 0.00-1.00

AIContradictsCaption.description: Raised for the reviewer's attention; resolves nothing by itself.

ReviewerDecision.description: Set only by a human reviewer. AI may never write this field.

ApprovedForReport.description: Derived from ReviewerDecision = Approved. Only human-approved evidence may appear in an official report (D-06).

DerivedFileKey.description: Report-ready or downscaled derivative, stored SEPARATELY from the original (D-13).

EntityVersion.description: Incremented on every material change. Referenced by Approvals.

ContentHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialisation of the fields listed in content_hash_fields.
